title: Documentation verification register
description: docs/verification.json: one record per page under content/docs, keyed by the page path without .mdx (for example "index" or "how-to/rotate-a-token"). scripts/check-verification.mjs enforces it: every page has a record, every record has a page, and every verifiedRevision equals the revision in docs-source.json.

form.description: The page's Diátaxis form, or landing for an entry page.

reader.description: The one reader the page is written for, and what that reader is trying to do.

verifiedRevision.description: The full commit of the documented project the page was checked against. Update it only after rechecking the page.

environments.description: Nix systems the page's commands ran on, for example aarch64-darwin.

ran.description: What was actually run or read to verify the page. Name commands and source documents.

notChecked.description: Claims the page makes that were not verified by a run, and why. Corrections made in review that were not re-run belong here.

tutorials/first-run.reader: A developer running the project for the first time
ran: Every bash fence on the page, in order, under env -i with a new HOME
notChecked: The optional cloud backend step needs credentials and was not run
